name: csSup_eq_greatestOfBdd
statement: Set ℤ} [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z ∈ s, z ≤ b) (Hinh : ∃ z : ℤ, z ∈ s) : sSup s = greatestOfBdd b Hb Hinh

name: csInf_eq_leastOfBdd
statement: Set ℤ} [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z ∈ s, b ≤ z) (Hinh : ∃ z : ℤ, z ∈ s) : sInf s = leastOfBdd b Hb Hinh
